title: mut.channel_amelia_wingerbearskin
mutation_directive: Lumen Prize winner — Amelia Winger-Bearskin (2025 · Special Commendation) — 'I WOULD LIKE TO BE MIDNIGHT / I WOULD LIKE TO BE SKY'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: Landscapes with all human infrastructure removed by AI — roads, fences, power lines erased to reveal a shared celestial sky as Indigenous commons. TECHNICAL HOOKS: Two-layer particle landscape: a 'built' layer (orthogonal grids, light pollution) that progressively erodes into the 'sky' layer (slow drift, deep field of stars) over a long cycle — geometry: dual point clouds with mask-blend; palette: sodium-orange dissolving into cobalt + starfield white. REF: https://lumenprize.org/2025-winners
